title: U2 font probe metrics (real SimpleGraphic.dll under Wine)
description: Written by probe/Launch.lua as out/metrics.json, copied to probe/expected/metrics.json by run.sh, compared by crates/pob-sg/tests/font_probe.rs. Indices: width[f][h][s], cursor[f][h][s][p] for fonts[f], heights[h], strings[s], points[p] (Lua arrays, 1-based in Lua, 0-based in JSON). Values are what Lua receives: DrawStringWidth(height, font, text) and DrawStringCursorIndex(height, font, text, x, y) with x = points[p][0], y = points[p][1] * height + points[p][2]; the cursor index is 1-based (r_main.cpp byte offset + 1). The probe forces SetDPIScaleOverridePercent(100), so screenScale must be 1 for the metrics to be physical pixels.

points.description: [x, ky, ay]: the cursor is at (x, ky * height + ay)
